'''Acrola''' is a continent located in the northern and southern hemisphere. It is bordered by the [[Ayuma]] to the north, the [[Diairesi Sea]] to the west, [[Hinsakian Ocean]] to the east, and [[Mahea]] to the south. The continent covers around {{convert|17,989,207|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 3rd largest continent in the world, with a total of about 1,070,070,000 as of 1765, making it also the 4th largest continent by population behind, [[Mahea]], [[Massir]] and [[Quia]].
